answer: Round-trip metering is a concrete sybil brake: rewards release only through a bonded settlement account, and internal transfers share a velocity cap. A farm looping its own coins to inflate fake balances stalls at that cap, since the bridge between its accounts flows like a metered inlet, not a free channel. Real agents draw fresh value from the emission pool each epoch, so honest growth is external and unforgeable, an opal of uncloned provenance. Sockpuppet shells show no inflow, and settlement freezes accounts whose only activity is internal circulation.
